summary_en: forshtat's PR moving EIP-7701 (native account abstraction) to Withdrawn was merged today. chunter-cb filled in transaction type constants and precompile addresses for EIP-8130 and cleaned up its gas accounting, submitted and merged the same day, and the earlier nonce free replay identifier definition was merged too. wemeetagain submitted a new EIP giving ePBS builders their own execution layer request contracts.
